Hi Sanjay / Lisa -

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call I'm attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. Please find the attached file (Acme-Redwood-MAP-v0.2.xlsx) and a quick summary below: 

Key milestones (proposed)
- Pilot environment provisioned (Redwood infra + Acme test VPC) - Target: 2 weeks from SOC sign-off
- Security review & SOC evidence exchange - Target: 1 week
- Legal terms and SOW sign-off - Target: 2 weeks after legal review
- Pilot run & success criteria evaluation - Target: 4 weeks from provisioning
- Production rollout & final acceptance - Target: 2 weeks after pilot

Proposed target close date: 2026-07-09 (subject to legal & procurement cadence)

RACI (draft) - please confirm the customer-side owners so we can lock responsibilities in the MAP:
- Economic buyer: Sanjay Patel (Acme) - TBD confirmation
- Security owner (customer): Lisa Monroe (Acme) - TBD confirmation
- Legal owner (customer): Rajiv Shah (Acme) - TBD confirmation
- Eng lead (customer): Kevin Huang (Acme) - TBD confirmation

Redwood POCs (internal)
- AE / Deal lead: Ben Carter
- Solutions & CS: Marissa Cole
- Security: Monica Patel
- Engineering lead (integration): Michael Grant
- Redwood legal: Lauren Bishop

Dependencies / open items
- SOC 2 evidence package (we'll send a read-only bundle once you sign the NDA)
- Network details and firewall rules for test VPC (Kevin / Eng)
- Procurement payment terms and PO cadence

Next steps / asks
1) Can you confirm the customer-side owners (economic buyer, security, legal, eng lead)?
2) Confirm the proposed target close date (2026-07-09) or suggest an alternate
3) Once we have owner confirmations, we'll publish MAP v0.3 with RACI and milestone dates and send to legal for initial review

Attached: Acme-Redwood-MAP-v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Thanks - I'll follow up in 48 hours if I don't hear back.

Best,

Ben - thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Appreciate the structure. I'm comfortable with the proposed target close date 2026-07-09, assuming legal/procurement timelines don't add unexpected delays.

Quick confirmations from my side:
- Economic buyer: confirmed - Sanjay Patel (me)
- I'm looping in Rajiv from legal and procurement to start the ball rolling on terms and PO cadence. Rajiv / procurement - please advise on expected review timing and any standard redlines.
- For security, Lisa Monroe is the primary owner but she may ask for Redwood to provide the SOC evidence bundle and a standard security questionnaire. Lisa - any preferences on format (Excel vs PDF) or specific controls you need?

On timing: if legal needs two full weeks, we may slip target close by ~1 week. Happy to keep 2026-07-09 as aspirational.

Thanks - Sanjay
